d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs and a loose, wind-swept texture. Sharp, narrow golden eyes with a cold expression. A mature appearance with a slender, toned build. The outfit is a revealing black bodysuit with gold accents, paired with a tattered, deep navy blue cloak and matching thigh-high black boots. Signature details include a small emerald green scarf around the neck and a massive, floating mechanical ring made of dark grey and gold metal hovering behind.
